hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: Recover G0002 as F[p]=s(p), G0003 as F[q]=s(q), and G0001 as the first divided difference F[p,q]=(F(p)-F(q))/(p-q).
required_assumptions: p and q are formal variables with p-q nonzero as a symbolic denominator.
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The catalog entries are exactly the two point evaluations of the latent function s and their first divided difference. The divided-difference operator reconstructs G0001 from the latent F and the two nodes, while substitution reconstructs the point values.
